title: SCA Minhag of the Week 260: "Dignified Wedding Ceremony Conclusion"

chapters.title: The end of the wedding ceremony and the breaking of the glass
chapters.about: breaking of the glass, people rushing the bride and groom

chapters.title: How weddings were conducted in earlier days
chapters.about: bride and groom walking out, standing in the lobby, orderly fashion

summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses how wedding ceremony conclusions and receptions have changed over time in the community. He contrasts the current practice of rushing the bride and groom with the orderly manner of earlier years, and contrasts modern lavish catered events with past weddings.
questions: What happened immediately after the breaking of the glass in past weddings?
How did guests greet the bride and groom after the ceremony in earlier days?
What was given to guests as a token of appreciation instead of a lavish meal?
How were weddings conducted in Halab in the past?
